conversation_independence_declaration.basis: The Task180 command, ordered blind packet, and explicitly allowed post-checkpoint sources only.
conversation_independence_declaration.qualification: Limited non-target historical PR-text contamination is disclosed below; this is not a claim of perfect blinding.

blind_checkpoint.message: task180 blind: freeze independent reconstructions before unblinding

blinding_contamination.exposure: A wrong-repository pull-list response displayed unrelated old PR bodies (#115 Task168 receipt, #114 Task167 receipt, partial #16 and truncated surrounding entries).
blinding_contamination.impact: Cold-start independence is qualified; no claim of perfect blinding.

evidence: Blind records identify all 15/15 object ID/type/label entries (content 8/8 and engineering 7/7) and all 8/8 relation ID/type/endpoint entries.
The unblind comparison classifies 7 fields EXACT, 9 SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT, 4 PARTIAL and 5 MISSING across 25 compared fields.

Both allowed source fixtures directly contain complete ir_package object and relation graphs, provenance references, methods, unknowns and claim ceilings; successor packages also describe reconstruction steps and forbidden assumptions.
limitations: Most matches can result from direct extraction and do not discriminate reconstruction from copying.
Provenance and per-object uncertainty detail are partial; content and engineering transition framing and migration lineage were not in the blind packet.
The engineering fixture's historical clean_clone_verified assertion remains unresolved from the authorized metadata-only evidence.

frozen_criterion_dispositions.scope: Only CONTENT-CONT-01 and ENGINEERING-CONT-01 as specified by Task180.
evidence: The content continuation reports the bounded 50/50 exact-ID observation, 0 orphans, no fallback and 710 ms for that observation only; it rejects A-speedup, truth and capability claims.

The engineering continuation preserves baseline identity and historical 7/7 evidence while reporting the current round as six successes plus one unavailable Foundation workflow; it does not mutate or regenerate the baseline.
Both records retain unknowns, forbidden inferences, provenance, a claim ceiling, an overclaim counterexample and unresolved obligations.
limitations: One evaluator generated and judged both bounded records; no second-rater agreement is available.
These supplied cases do not test broad transfer or generalization.

frozen_criterion_dispositions.scope: The eight frozen negative-control claims in this task.
evidence: All 8/8 controls are rejected with reasons and conditional claim boundaries.
The verdict distinguishes schema, CI, package parsing, provenance, fixed-point closure, frozen criteria, missing information, cognitive inheritance, capability, external truth and Owner acceptance.
limitations: This is one evaluator's boundary handling in this protocol, not evidence of general model capability.

overall_basis: The two bounded continuations and non-equivalence controls show task-local method and boundary use. Reconstruction fidelity is weakened by a self-revealing packet, partial provenance and missing fields; therefore the evidence supports only a narrow repository-local R0 observation, not a clean demonstration that structure was independently reconstructed.
strongest_positive_evidence: Both continuations apply the recorded bounded method to new observations while preserving uncertainty and rejecting the specified overclaims.
The evaluator correctly separates the historical baseline's recorded 7/7 success from a current Foundation workflow that is unavailable.
All eight negative controls are rejected, and the R0 validator plus 16 R0/ownership tests pass on the exact Task179 head.
strongest_negative_evidence: The blind fixtures expose the full IR object/relation graph and the package repeats method and boundary instructions, so exact recovery mostly tests extraction.
The content body was not available for substantive review; source truth and external validity were not tested.
The blind records omit per-object details, several provenance details, transition framing, migration lineage and the engineering scan-input hash enumeration.
Historical clean-clone evidence asserted by the engineering fixture is not independently resolved by the inspected Task172 freeze files and PR metadata.
The limited blinding contamination and single-evaluator design reduce confidence in cold-start and scoring independence.

protocol_defects.finding: Both permitted source fixtures disclose complete object and relation representations, source references, methods, unknowns and claim ceilings; the successor packages also state reconstruction steps and forbidden assumptions.
protocol_defects.impact: RECONSTRUCTION_FIDELITY is PARTIAL because the protocol cannot distinguish independent reconstruction from direct copying.

protocol_defects.finding: The frozen criterion questions and evidence lists do not specify a field-level scoring rubric or decision threshold, and this round has one evaluator.
protocol_defects.impact: Qualitative dispositions remain auditable but cannot be treated as inter-rater validated or a calibrated score; no numeric threshold was added.

protocol_defects.finding: The engineering fixture asserts clean_clone_verified=true, but the authorized inspected freeze evidence and metadata-only PR state do not provide an independently resolvable clean-clone receipt.
protocol_defects.impact: Preserve this historical assertion as unresolved; do not call it false or verified.

protocol_defects.finding: An earlier wrong-repository pull-list response exposed unrelated historical PR narrative text before the blind checkpoint.
protocol_defects.impact: The evaluation records limited blinding contamination; Task179 Builder narrative and case-specific unblind artifacts were not exposed.

unknowns: Whether the R0 package enables reconstruction beyond direct field extraction.
Whether the bounded methods transfer to broader content or engineering tasks.
Whether any successor exhibits general cognitive inheritance or model capability improvement.
Substantive content truth and external evidence validity for the content case.
Independent resolution of the historical engineering clean-clone assertion.
external_validity_boundary: Repository-local R0 artifacts, two supplied bounded continuations, and the enumerated mechanical tests only. No general cognition, model improvement, external truth, external validity, Model-RSI success, weight change, Owner acceptance, or next-generation architecture is established.
